decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 0.9803. Series context: trend strength 0.9604 and seasonal strength 0.1701; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.201); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.225.
